# KP:1 Knowledge Pack Format

> A plain-text format for keeping knowledge with its context, evidence, uncertainty and history. A person keeps a pack as an ordinary file, and any AI assistant can write one.

## Make a Knowledge Pack

- [Create a Knowledge Pack](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tymofiy/kp/main/agent/CREATE-A-PACK.md): every step, the honesty rules, file templates and a complete example. Start here if a person asked you to make a pack.
- [Quick checker](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tymofiy/kp/main/agent/kp_quick_check.py): a single Python file with no dependencies. It reports and never refuses.

## Read further

- [Guide for AI agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tymofiy/kp/main/AGENTS.md): which parts of the repository to read for each task.
- [Core format](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tymofiy/kp/main/spec/CORE.md): the normative format.
- [Authoring guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tymofiy/kp/main/spec/AUTHORING.md): how to choose claim types, nature and confidence.
